title: Tropic Skincare’s Susie Ma to return to Dragons’ Den in permanent role
summary: Susie Ma, founder of Tropic Skincare, first rose to fame on The Apprentice. Now, she’s taking a permanent position within the Dragons’ Den, succeeding Touker Suleyman, who departs to focus on beauty venture Lipstick London
